policy.scope: NSW only. 2001-current PSI files (annual + current-year weekly bundles). 1990-2000 archive deferred to a later backfill.
policy.download_method_note: The __psi bulk-download path and the PDF documentation assets on valuergeneral.nsw.gov.au are behind a Cloudflare managed JS challenge that plain HTTP clients (curl, fetch) cannot pass. Files were retrieved via a real headed browser session (gstack /browse skill, per project CLAUDE.md instructions for all web browsing) navigating the official public listing page and using its own download links — the same access a human user has via their browser. This is not a commercial/protected portal: it is the official CC-licensed NSW Government bulk open-data distribution named explicitly in this task's scope.

entries.dataset_name: NSW Valuer General Property Sales Information (PSI) — 2001 to current
entries.geography_level: district (VG numeric code) -> street/suburb/postcode as published per record
entries.file_format: zip-of-zips (annual bundle) containing per-week zips, each containing ';'-delimited fixed-structure .DAT text files, one per district per week
entries.record_format: Record types: A (file header), B (sale record: property id, address, sale price, contract/settlement dates, zoning, nature of property, area, unit type), C (legal description, multi-line), D (linked/related records), Z (file trailer). Validated directly against a real downloaded sample record (PDF documentation is also Cloudflare-protected and was not retrievable this session).
entries.licence_notes: CC BY 4.0 (NSW Government open data policy)
known_limitations: Sale price includes non-arm's-length and nominal-value transfers that must be flagged/excluded from market price statistics
Settlement lag: a sale can appear in the weekly file weeks after its contract date

District code (not LGA name) is the geographic key on each record; this pipeline instead matches the record's own suburb-name/postcode text fields against a pilot allow-list derived spatially from the ASGS backbone

No lat/lon or SA1/SA2/SAL/POA code on the record — suburb/postcode text matching to core.dim_geography is inherently imperfect and carries lower correspondence confidence than the ABS SA1-allocation-based joins used in Sprints 2-4
entries.intended_core_table: core.fact_residential_sales_summary (curated summary only — no raw transaction table promoted to Supabase)
entries.notes: Verified via a real browser session: listing page loaded, annual bundle pattern confirmed (files on disk: 2021.zip, 2022.zip, 2023.zip, 2024.zip, 2025.zip), weekly pattern confirmed (16 current-year files on disk). Plain-HTTP re-check this run: listing=200, bulk-endpoint=403 (403/challenge expected for the latter).

entries.dataset_name: NSW Valuer General Property Sales Information — 1990 to 2001 archive
entries.official_url_note: the interactive propertySalesInformation launch app itself returns 'currently unavailable' as of Sprint 11 Workstream 8 — the direct __psi/yearly/<YYYY>.zip download pattern (same domain, same as 2001-current) works regardless and was used directly.
entries.format_guide_url_note: the original valuergeneral.nsw.gov.au PDF path now 404s after its Cloudflare redirect — NSW Government appears to have migrated documentation assets to the consolidated nsw.gov.au domain; found live via the nsw.gov.au resource-library page, not guessed.
entries.file_format: annual zip, single ARCHIVE_SALES_<YYYY>.DAT flat file per year — verified against the official format fact sheet, materially fewer fields than 2001-current (no settlement_date, no nature_of_property)
entries.notes: Sprint 11 Workstream 8: all 11 years (1990-2000) downloaded via the gstack /browse skill in headed mode (plain curl still 403s on valuergeneral.nsw.gov.au — confirmed unchanged since Sprint 5), 1,917,667 transaction rows after exact-duplicate collapse, dwelling_type classified from zone_code + a strata-plan text pattern (no nature_of_property field exists in this format, so classification confidence is necessarily lower than 2001-current — see nsw_sales_archive_local_store_report.md). Branch promotion deliberately deferred — would touch the already-live core.fact_residential_sales_summary that existing comparison APIs read from.
